Name: Less Rusty Farm Bridges
Author: Ritto09
Description:
Sometimes I want to play on the hilltop and riverland farms, but the planks always stopped me. So I made this mod for a personal reason. The bridges still have a simple and rusty look, just not the decade old, creaky, screws popping out kind of rusty.

You'll need to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27117]Sharogg's tilesheets[/url] for this mod to work.

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Sharogg]Sharogg[/url] for such nice bridges.

Manifest.Name: Less Rusty Farm Bridges
Manifest.Description: Replaces the bridges in Hilltop and Riverland farms.
